en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਸਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: eik kavaau pasaau kar kudharat a(n)dhar keeaa pasaaraa|

en.bdb: The Lord’s one word (order) established and spread the whole nature in the form of the cosmos.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਿ ਤਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਚਹੁੰ ਖਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)j tat paravaan kar chahu(n) khaanee vich sabh varataaraa|

en.bdb: Making the five elements authentic (He) regularized the working of the four mines of origin (egg, fetus, sweat, vegetation) of life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਖੀਐ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਤੋਲੁ ਅਗਾਸ ਅਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd dharatee aakheeaai kevadd tol agaas akaaraa|

en.bdb: How to tell the expanse of earth and extension of sky?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਪਵਣੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਤੋਲੁ ਵਿਥਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd pavan vakhaaneeaai kevadd paanee tol vithaaraa|

en.bdb: How mush wider is air and what is the weight of water?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਅਗਨੀ ਭਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd aganee bhaar hai tul na tul atol bha(n)ddaaraa|

en.bdb: The mass of fire cannot be estimated. The stores of that Lord cannot be counted and weighed.
When His creation can not be counted how can one know how great the Creator is.
